tools.name: planerio_list_shifts
tools.description: List the planned shifts between two dates: shift id, start and end time, employee (name, personnel number, employee_uuid), shift group, workplace, location, tags and last change. By default only published plans and no deleted shifts. Use updated_after for changes since a date. Sorted by start time.

tools.name: planerio_list_shift_cards
tools.description: List the staffing requirement defined in shift cards: workplace, location, shift group, validity, weekdays, times, shift type, required qualifications and the shifts of each card with priority and pre-planned employee. Filter by validity dates. Read-only.

tools.name: planerio_list_staff
tools.description: List the current staff supply for resource planning: name, personnel number, primary shift group, qualifications, weekly hours and days, hours per weekday, entry and exit date. Use it together with planerio_list_shift_cards. For plain employee master data use planerio_list_employees. Read-only.

tools.name: planerio_list_employees
tools.description: List the employee master data valid on a reference date: employee_uuid, names, email, personnel number, shift groups, entry and exit date, work schedule (weekly hours, job title, tariff), supervisor, cost center, occupational category, date of birth. Personal data: ask only for what the task needs.

tools.name: planerio_list_absences
tools.description: List the absence periods that overlap two dates: employee, dates and times, calendar and working days, status (ACCEPTED, OPEN, REJECTED, DELETED), absence type and comment. By default only approved absences. Use include_open for requests that wait for approval. Read-only. Long lists are cut: use off

tools.name: planerio_get_vacation_days
tools.description: Get the vacation days per employee for one year: allowance, carry-over from the last year, expired, requested, approved, taken and remaining. Only for Planerio 1.5 (not 2.0); Planerio replaces this endpoint in 2026/27. Read-only.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: planerio_list_employees, planerio_list_absences · Public sink: planerio_list_employees.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: planerio_list_employees, planerio_list_absences · Public sink: planerio_list_employees

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
